title: Fox Dragon on Floating Isle
description: A vibrant red fox with large bat-like dragon wings and a braided mane sits on a small grassy floating island. The surreal scene features a swirling colorful vortex below, a large multi-eyed dark tree behind it, floating pink pixel hearts, and a grotesque red HP-labeled creature dripping in the foreground against a purple eye-filled sky.
